newsitem.title: AFGHANISTAN: Taleban beat five female aid workers in Kabul.
newsitem.headline: Taleban beat five female aid workers in Kabul.

text.p: Five female aid workers were beaten in the Afghan capital Kabul on Saturday by Taleban authorities, an aid official said on Sunday.
The official, who did not wish to be named, said the five Afghan women were travelling in a car belonging to Care International, a foreign aid agency.
"Five women in a Care vehicle were stopped by the religious police in two vehicles equipped with loudspeakers," the official said.

"The loudspeakers announced that all foreign NGOs (non-governmental organisations) were bad and that the women who worked for them were prostitutes. They said that the women should get their salary and food from God, not from NGOs.
"The women were ordered out of the car, and as they got out they were beaten." the aid worker said.
The aid worker said that the women had received bruises in the incident but no major injuries.
